notes.title: Delay/Demo & Key Info!
notes.content: [p][b]Hello everyone,[/b][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Some of you might have seen this coming but we’ve decided to postpone the game. To be transparent: we’re currently working with a PR agency, and their advice was to wait until [i]Silksong[/i]’s release date announcement. Like many of you, we didn’t expect that to happen so soon![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]At first, we thought we could still launch in October or November, but with so many games moving to Q4, the competition has become pretty intense. The exact date isn’t locked yet, but the release will land no later than after the February Next Fest, most likely sometime between January and March. We’ll keep you updated as soon as the agency sets the new release date.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]The good news:[/b] since we now have a bit more time, we’ve decided to prepare a proper demo! Originally, the plan was to go straight to release, but we think this will be a great way for you to get a first taste of the game. Expect more details soon.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][u]We can also confirm a couple of things many of you have asked about:[/u][/p][list][*][p]The game will be priced around $10, with fair regional pricing.[/p][/*][*][p]It’s more ambitious and longer than [i]Nocturnal 1[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]The game will be available in 11 languages, we've recently added Polish & Turkish.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]We can’t wait to share the demo with you and hear your feedback![/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Gabriel[/p][p]The Sunnyside Team[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2847780/Nocturnal_2/?curator_clanid=4777282"][/dynamiclink][b][u]Latest trailer:[/u][/b][/p][previewyoutube="pGBUATKm0no;full"][/previewyoutube]
